title: ENGINE CONTROL CABLES - SERVICING
question: What is the recommended internal lubrication procedure for the outer housing of housed, pull-type, push-pull, or vernier controls?
answer: All housed, pull-type, push-pull or vernier controls should have each outer housing lightly lubricated internally with VV-L-800 General Purpose Lube Oil.
